purpose: Permanent deterministic comparison cases for Milestone 1 terrain, crust-age, erosion, and gas-giant regressions.

cases.description: Known pre-Milestone-1 case containing long tectonic lineaments, weak erosion, and dense drainage.
Exposes continental plate-boundary cuts and verifies that erosion remains climate-sensitive.
Exercises ridge seeding, oceanic crust age, subsidence, shelves, and horizontal wrapping.
Verifies the atmospheric-only output contract, deterministic colors, and repeated-generation stability.
